name: qlrisk_risk_report
title: Unified risk report
description: Every risk in one call: PV, sensitivities, VaR, ES, parametric VaR, SVaR, stress, backtest, FRTB SA, exposure, rolled up a hierarchy with optional limit checks. use_demo_book=true runs qlrisk's six-trade demo book. Inputs: trades, use_demo_book, measures, limits. Example: {"use_demo_book": true, "limits": [{"name": "Firm 1d VaR", "metric": "var.1d", "limit": 500000}]} gives the headline metrics (pv.total, var.1d, es.1d, svar.10d, frtb_sa.total, exposure) and each limit's status (the demo book is valued today).
